title: Adaptive Greedy Frame Selection for Long Video Understanding

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if AI could watch hours of video in seconds?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Long videos slow down AI, making answers lag.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Adaptive greedy frame selection picks key frames for faster processing.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses a scoring system to choose the most important frames dynamically.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This helps models answer questions on 10+ hour videos in minutes.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is smarter frame selection, not just more frames.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how AI thinks when watching a 24-hour movie?
